Compact.description:
Compact mode, as in Zen Browser: the chosen bars stay hidden and slide in
while the pointer rests at their edge of the window, leaving the listing
alone on screen. Off by default, so the window keeps its full chrome until
someone asks for less.

animation_ms.description: Length of the slide in and out, in ms; 0 = no animation.

edge_px.description: Depth of the strip along each edge that calls its bars, in px.

frame_px.description:
Width of the frame around the listing, which then sits in a card with
rounded corners, as Zen's compact mode does; 0 = no frame.

hide_bottom_bar.description: The bottom bar: filter, counts, zoom (bottom edge).

hide_delay_ms.description: How long the bars stay after the pointer leaves them, in ms.

hide_header.description:
The address bar: back, forward, path, refresh, view buttons (top
edge, under the tabs).

hide_sidebar.description: The sidebar with the places (left edge).

overlay.description:
When shown, the bars float over the listing (`true`), so it does not
move, or push it aside (`false`), so nothing of it is covered.

reveal_delay_ms.description: How long the pointer rests at an edge before its bars come, in ms.

store.description: Performance logging for the persistence layer (`nohrs-store`).

DiagnosticsStore.description:
Performance logging for the SQLite / redb store. All off by default, so a
default config adds no overhead. Output goes through `tracing` (targets
`nohrs_store::sql` / `nohrs_store::redb`) and is filterable with `RUST_LOG`.

log_redb_ops.description: Log redb `get`/`put`/`delete`/`batch` operations and their durations.

slow_query_ms.description:
Log SQL queries slower than this many milliseconds at `warn`. Zero (the
default) disables slow-query logging.

DockSide.description: A side of the area a panel docks to.

restore_tabs.description: When enabled, the previous session's tabs are restored on restart (§4).

reveal_from_other_apps.description:
Whether "show in folder" from other programs (Premiere's Reveal in
Explorer, a browser's Show in folder) opens here instead of Explorer.

split_direction.description: Orientation a fresh split uses unless overridden by the split shortcut.

synced_panes.description: When enabled, navigating in one pane mirrors the path into the others.

FileTypeColorRule.description: A filename pattern and its configured display colour.

pattern.description: Case-insensitive filename globs such as `*.rs;*.toml` or `README*`.

IndexSource.description:
Where the whole-computer name search gets its file names.

The whole-computer search (`Ctrl+E`) needs every name on the drives from
somewhere. This app can keep that list itself, or borrow the one an
installed Everything (voidtools) already keeps.

oneOf.description:
Everything's own index while it is open, this app's own otherwise,
decided on the first whole-computer search (the default).

The index this app builds: it walks the drives, or reads the NTFS
master file table through its Windows service when that is installed.

The index of an installed Everything, read through its SDK or its own
IPC window, so nothing is indexed here.

exclude.description: Paths and globs excluded from indexing.

mode.description: When the background index is built and maintained.

source.description: Where the whole-computer name search gets its file names.

IndexingExclude.description: Paths and globs excluded from indexing.

paths.description: Literal paths (absolute or relative to the indexed root) to skip.

IndexingMode.description: When the filesystem index is built and kept up to date.

oneOf.description: Index on demand and keep warm while the app is in use (the default).
Continuously index in the background, even while idle.

Keybindings.description:
Keybinding overrides (config.md §2, draft for P3).

A draft surface: a map of action identifier to key chord (e.g.
`"quit" = "ctrl-q"`). An empty map — the default — means the built-in keymap
is used. The action vocabulary and live re-binding are defined in P3; until
then values are stored and validated but not applied (hot reload is a
restart, config.md §5), so arbitrary action names are accepted without
warning to keep forward compatibility.

hotkey.description: Global hotkey that summons the launcher.

position_remember.description: Whether the launcher reopens at its last on-screen position.

Layout.description:
Where the window's panels sit and how the tabs are laid out. Each panel
docks to one side of what it accompanies: the sidebar and the preview to a
side of the listing, the terminal to a side of the panes.

move_grips.description:
A grip in the middle of each panel's edge that carries the panel to
another side. Off by default: dragging it was not obvious, and the
sides are also chosen here and from the bubbles of the listing's edges.

preview.description: The side the preview docks to.

preview_visible.description:
Whether the preview panel is shown. Written whenever the preview is
toggled, so a window closed with it hidden opens that way again.

sidebar.description: The side the sidebar with the places docks to.

terminal.description: The side the terminal docks to.

vertical_tabs.description:
Tabs in a column down the side of the window, as in Zen Browser,
instead of a row along the top.

vertical_tabs_side.description: The side the vertical tabs run down: `left` or `right`.

Plugins.description:
Plugin selection (config.md §2, reserved for P4).

Type definition / reservation only: the lists are parsed and stored, but no
plugin host loads them yet (that lands in P4).

community.description: Community plugins to enable, as `user/repo` or a URL.

core.description: Built-in (first-party) plugins to enable, by id (e.g. `"git"`).

SearchBackend.description: The engine used to answer content searches.

oneOf.description: Pick the best available backend at runtime (the default).

SortOrder.description: The column a directory listing is ordered by.

SplitDirection.description: How a 2-way split arranges its panes.

oneOf.description: Panes side by side, separated by a vertical divider (`Cmd+\`).
Panes stacked, separated by a horizontal divider (`Cmd+Shift+\`).

accent.description:
Accent colour: one of the named colours the settings page offers
(`orange`, `blue`, `teal`, `green`, `purple`, `pink`, `red`) or a
`#rrggbb` hex string. Anything else falls back to orange.

background.description:
Background of the content areas as a `#rrggbb` hex string; empty keeps
the palette's own. The text and the surfaces around it (hover, borders,
chrome) are shaded from it, on whichever side of it reads.

mode.description: Light/dark selection, or following the OS.

oneOf.description: Follow the operating system's light/dark preference.

app_name.description: Custom title shown in the main window title bar; empty uses the product name.

audio_waveforms.description:
Whether sound files show their waveform instead of their icon in the
icons view.

default_sort.description: Column the listing is sorted by on load.

default_sort_descending.description: Whether that default runs from Z to A, largest or newest first.

file_type_colors.description: Ordered file-name glob rules and their text colours; the first match wins.

font_family.description:
Font family of the whole interface, by its installed name
(`Microsoft YaHei UI`); empty keeps the system's own.

hover_audio.description: Whether resting the mouse on a sound file in the listing plays it.

hover_audio_delay_ms.description: How long the mouse rests on a sound file before it plays, in ms.

icon_pack.description: Identifier of the icon pack used to render entries.

language.description:
Interface language: `"auto"` follows the Windows regional format
(then the country), or one of `"pt-BR"`, `"en"`, `"es"`, `"fr"`, `"de"`,
`"it"`, `"ru"`, `"ja"`, `"zh-CN"`.

name_lines.description:
Most lines a name takes under an icon in the icons view, the last
one ending in "…" when the name needs more; 0 = no limit.

preview_autoplay.description: Whether a video or sound starts playing as soon as the preview opens it.

scroll_smoothness.description:
How smoothly the mouse wheel scrolls the listing, 0..=100: 0 moves
in steps, 100 glides for longest.

show_hidden.description: Whether dotfiles are shown in listings.

show_quick_access.description:
Whether the sidebar starts with the Windows Quick access section (the
folders pinned and found frequent in Explorer).

welcome_done.description: Whether the welcome screen was gone through; false shows it on start.

Updates.description:
Automatic updates. Only an installed copy updates itself; one run from a
build folder never does, whatever this says.

automatic.description:
Look for a new version when the app starts, download it in the
background and install it when the app closes.

description:
The fully merged, validated configuration.

Models the P1 surface (`theme` / `ui`) plus the P2 sections: `[indexing]`,
`[search]`, `[launcher]`, and `[diagnostics]`. `[keybindings]` and
`[plugins]` are reserved here as forward-compatible drafts — their types are
defined and parsed leniently so files can adopt them now, but the values do
not drive behaviour yet (keybindings land in P3, plugins in P4; see
`docs/config.md` §2/§5).

Only `theme`, `ui`, and `diagnostics` are consumed at runtime today. The
remaining sections (`keybindings`, `plugins`, `indexing`, `search`,
`launcher`) are accepted and validated now so files and editor completion can
adopt them, but editing them has no effect until the matching subsystem is
wired in a later phase — see the per-section notes and `docs/config.md` §5.

Every field is `#[serde(default)]`: the loader starts from
[`Config::default`] and overlays only the keys present in the file, so a
missing section is filled with its default rather than rejected. The
generated schema therefore has no `required` properties, matching the
loader (an empty `config.toml` is valid).

compact.description: Compact mode: the tab row hidden until the pointer reaches it.

keybindings.description:
Keybinding overrides (draft; full support in P3). Empty means the
built-in keymap is used.

layout.description: Where the sidebar, preview and terminal dock, and the tabs' layout.

plugins.description: Plugin selection (reserved; full support in P4).

schema_version.description: On-disk schema version. Must be [`CURRENT_SCHEMA_VERSION`] for this build.

updates.description: Automatic updates from the project's releases.
